owner: Dept D/C worker (child session 2026-11-08, D-025); Pre-registration Officer: Director's brief
hypothesis: A pre-registered hypothesis under test, not an edge claim. Bloomberg bond indices extend duration at the month-end strike (16:00 ET since 2021-01-14, 15:00 before); passive funds, insurers and benchmarked dealers buy duration into it (NY Fed: month-end volume 46-58% above normal, 20% of last-day volume in the 10 minutes around 16:00 in 2025; Hartley-Schwarz cash Treasuries 1990-2018 about 20-25 bp/month at 10y concentrated in the last days; Allocate Smartly TLT last three days +0.13%/day 1999-2019). Variant B of AF C-1-01 (new): capture the last-three-days drift inside futures-firm trading days by overnight-session holds. Sign fixed: LONG.
rules: Data: Databento GLBX.MDP3 ohlcv-1h, stype_in=continuous, symbol <ROOT>.v.0 (front by volume), purchased 2026-11-08 by batch job (estimate row in data/databento_spend_ledger.csv first); ingested to DATA_ROOT/derived/<dataset>.parquet with ts = bar OPEN in UTC, columns open/high/low/close/volume/instrument_id; rows >= 2025-01-01 go only to DATA_ROOT/holdout/<dataset>_holdout.parquet. A 1h bar exists only if the contract traded in that hour. Every ET time below is America/New_York via zoneinfo; because ET is a whole-hour offset from UTC, 'the bar opening HH:00 ET' is exactly one Databento bar. Roll rule (ex ante): a return between two prices is used only if both bars carry the same instrument_id (the .v.0 mapping changes at a session boundary); otherwise the observation is ineligible and counted. Instruments UB (Ultra T-bond) and ZN (10-year note), traded together at equal risk. Month-end events: T = last XNYS session of each calendar month; holding sessions s in {T-2, T-1, T} (XNYS sessions). For each s: ENTRY at the OPEN of the bar opening 18:00 ET on the Globex evening that starts session s (the calendar day before s; the Sunday before when s is a Monday; for a session after a holiday, the evening of the holiday); if that bar is missing, the OPEN of the first existing bar opening 19:00..21:00 ET that evening, else no trade. EXIT at the CLOSE of the bar opening 15:00 ET on s (last trade before 16:00 ET); if s is an XNYS early-close day or that bar is missing, the CLOSE of the last existing bar opening 11:00..14:00 ET on s (counted and reported); else no trade. Entry and exit bars must carry one instrument_id. Session P&L (fraction of account) = sum over the two instruments of w_i*ln(P_exit/P_entry) - costs. Flat by 16:00 ET every session; re-entered each evening. No stops or targets.
parameters: events = sessions T-2, T-1, T of each month (T = last XNYS session); entry 18:00 ET bar open of the session's Globex evening; exit 15:00 ET bar close (=16:00 ET); UB + ZN equal risk; +-25% neighbours (fixed now): event set {T-1, T} (2 days, x0.67, the nearest integer) and {T-3..T} (4 days, x1.33); exit at the CLOSE of the 14:00 ET bar (hold 20 h, -5%; the hold cannot extend past 16:00 under the firm deadline); EWMA centre of mass 45 and 75; one-bar delay variant = entry at the OPEN of the 19:00 ET bar; volatility terciles = ZN trailing 20-session s.d. of the 18:00->16:00 return (IS bounds)
instruments: CBOT UB and ZN front futures (by volume)
holding: 22 h overnight session (18:00 ET -> 16:00 ET next day), 3 sessions per month, 2 legs: about 36 sessions and 72 round trips per year
data_sha256: PINNED AT INGEST (data bought after this registration): the sha256 of each derived parquet is written to data/manifest.csv before the first gateway read, and the result file prints manifest = recomputed for every dataset
vol_scaler: w_i = (0.10/sqrt(252))/sigma_i, sigma_i = EWMA (centre of mass 60 sessions, at least 40) s.d. of the instrument's own 18:00->16:00 ET session log return over ALL prior sessions with valid bars (event or not), through the previous session; no cap/floor.
cost_model: 1x per side on notional (point value $1,000 x price): UB 1 tick (1/32 = $31.25) + $2.50; ZN 1 tick (1/64 = $15.625) + $2.50; charged at entry and exit (overnight-session entries assumed at the same 1-tick floor). 2x run attached (every per-side cost doubled).
decision_rule: Gate v2 on the OOS window only, exactly one read through qe.gateway.load(id,'oos') per dataset in one run (the IS read for EWMA warm-up precedes it): pass iff (1) the deciding one-sided t (minimum of iid, Newey-West and the event/day-clustered t of the net-1x series) >= 3.6807 AND the stationary-bootstrap (>= 430,000 draws) one-sided lower bound at alpha 0.05/430 > 0; (2) net-2x mean > 0 (criterion 3); (3) criteria 4 and 7 of PARAMETERS.md: at least 70% of OOS calendar years positive, no single year > 50% of a positive net, at least 2 of 3 volatility terciles (bounds from IS) positive, the +-25% neighbours listed in parameters all net-positive, and the one-bar-delay variant net-positive; (4) Red Team and re-implementation sign-off; (5) hold-out read on the *_holdout datasets in the restated one-sided tolerance form with h = decay_haircut. Verdict mechanically: PASS Gate 3 if (1)-(3) hold; NEAR-MISS if the deciding t is within 1.0 of the bar (t >= 2.6807) with the bootstrap 5th percentile of the mean > 0; else FAIL (refuted under the row's rule). Before the OOS read, on IS only: the truncation harness (delete every bar after the entry instant; the decision must not change) and the perturbation harness (1% noise on post-entry bars) must pass on >= 30 sampled IS events, and a planted look-ahead must fail. The result file prints criterion-4 power and the joint figure for its own OOS length. Series: the per-session net P&L (one observation per holding session; NW lag 3; clustered by month-end event). Concentration also requires neither instrument > 75% of a positive net and no single event-day position (T-2/T-1/T) > 60% of it. Sub-periods (information only): 2015-01..2019-10 (inside the cash/ETF evidence years), 2019-11..2024-12 (dates no evidence touched), 2015-01..2021-01-13 (15:00 strike) vs 2021-01-14.. (16:00 strike), 2022-03.. (hiking cycle).
notes: Source: research/triage-2026-11-08.md class C #3 (AF C-1-01, variant B), prescreen-2026-11-06 #2. EVIDENCE WINDOW: cash Treasuries 1990-2018 (Hartley-Schwarz), Treasury ETFs to 2019-10 (Allocate Smartly), cash-volume facts 2015-2025 (NY Fed, no returns). ZN/UB futures returns at the strike, and the overnight-session hold, were never measured in any source: the decision market is untouched by the evidence (D-009), so the default OOS 2015-2024 is kept and the 2019-11.. part is printed separately. Both UB and ZN are traded (the prescreen preferred UB alone; with UB alone the OOS has 360 trades but ZN adds the second leg and the variance reduction; ZN is marginal on costs, which the 2x run shows). Institutional change dates: 2015-01 (month-end volume regime), 2021-01-14 (strike 15:00 -> 16:00 ET; the 16:00 exit is after the old strike and just before the new one), 2022-03 (hiking). OOS 10.0 years: bar 1.16 annual Sharpe (event series); criterion-4 power 0.86/1.00/1.00 at true Sharpe 1.5/2.0/2.4; at the triage's realistic S it is about 0.24 or less. Closed families: none (H0023 is S&P turn-of-month). HONEST PRIOR about 0.05. Firm clauses: overnight-session futures (18:00 ET entry is the start of the firm trading day; exit 16:00 ET inside Topstep 16:10, MFFU 16:10, Lucid/Tradeify 16:45; Bulenox 16:59); consistency rules touched (P&L in 36 sessions/yr); no scheduled release at 18:00 or 16:00 ET. Family treasury-month-end-strike holds 1 of 5 counts.
